# [1.10.0](https://github.com/docbt/patched-up/compare/v1.9.0...v1.10.0) (2026-07-18)


### Features

* **googlenews:** support v5.163.0.947799485 and fix fresh-install sign-in loop ([3cd524a](https://github.com/docbt/patched-up/commit/3cd524a947a094114c8f0d0ea5be154935010fa3)), closes [#44](https://github.com/docbt/patched-up/issues/44)

patches.name: Hide Pur
patches.description: Hides the Pur ad-free subscription option from the settings menu.

patches.name: Hide ads
patches.description: Hides sponsored ads and Google Ads. Also disables Microsoft Clarity analytics.

patches.name: Remove tracking parameters from share URLs
patches.description: Strips UTM tracking parameters from URLs shared via the in-app share function.

patches.name: Enable CustomTabs
patches.description: Enables CustomTabs to open articles in your default browser.

patches.name: GmsCore support
patches.description: Allows Google News to sign in via MicroG (GmsCore) instead of Google Play Services when installed under a renamed package.
